next_step: Run 2-week Hosted POC (search + nightly batch embed) -> performance report -> Dedicated pricing demo
notes: Mid-market product analytics SaaS. Narrowed to embeddings + semantic search for product/content search and guided help. Wants to try Redwood Hosted first (fast time-to-value) then move to Dedicated if throughput/cost predictability looks good. Team: 2 backend engineers, 1 infra, 1 product ML. Current infra: PostgreSQL + Elastic for search; experimenting with Pinecone/Weaviate for vector store. Key asks: 1) Can Redwood handle mixing streamed query-time embeddings with precomputed batch embeddings? 2) Integration pattern with third-party vector DBs; prefer simple connector / minimal SDK changes. 3) Nightly batch job: ~200k docs/week -> cost estimate request. Latency target: p90 < 120ms for retrieval + re-rank. Throughput target: sustained 80–120 QPS for semantic search peak. Cost sensitivity: medium; wants obvious cost levers (batching, quantization). Security: SOC2 required, SSO + audit logs, KMS for keys. Quote from CTO: "We need predictable costs for our search index rebuild windows — spikes must not blow the budget."

technical_requirements:
- Precompute nightly embeddings for ~200k docs/week, store in external vector DB.
- Query-time flow: embed query (hosted or local), top-k retrieve from vector DB, optional Redwood re-rank/generation step.
- Throughput: sustained 80-120 QPS; target p95 latency for retrieval+re-rank < 200ms.
- Model preferences: open models supported (Llama2-style), support for quantized variants; allow routing to cheaper model variants on fallback.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency, tracing hooks for debugging.
- Billing: need monthly burn forecast for POC and for Dedicated reserved capacity options.
poC_details: 2-week Hosted POC scoped: 1) 50k precomputed embeddings run using Redwood hosted embeddings API; 2) Query volume sim to peak (100 QPS) using synthetic load; 3) Measure end-to-end p90 latency and token cost per query; 4) Validate connector to Pinecone + sample rollback to local Elastic for fallback.
pricing_questions: Asked for: 1) unit token/embedding pricing for Hosted API; 2) Dedicated committed pricing tiers for mid-market (monthly GPU pools); 3) discounts for batch embedding usage and reserved bursts; 4) example TCO for 200k embed/week + 100 QPS search traffic
internal_stakeholders: CTO (Ari Mendoza), Head of Product (Lina Park), Infra Lead (Marcus Holt)
competitive_notes: Evaluating Pinecone + vendor-managed embeddings (vendor X) in parallel. Important differentiation: Redwood's Dedicated fallback policies and clear unit economics; competitor risk: vendor lock-in to vector DB, unclear cost of scaling queries.
